body: commit ab77c35 -- Control/Disruptor built from the alchemy lore transcript. Passive: threshold-crossing Flow trigger. Q: hit + armor-shred debuff. W: this roster's first-ever real stun. R: TOTAL armor mirrors a locked target's, live -- makes Zagan weaker when he engages a squishy target, a genuine new risk/reward lever no other kit has. Also fixed two pre-existing bugs found during wiring: stale ARENA_HERO_MNM network pick bound, missing Weatherman case in arena_hero_name, stale duplicated ARENA_HERO_COUNT in arena_bot. 9 new tests + tags test, full suite (764 checks) + test_10_bots.sh green.
title: S170-230: hero Zagan, The Standstill's Confessor -- 28th hero, unique meta-changing kit
